item.description: ### Languages - Brisa is now available in English, French and Spanish. It follows your Mac's language, or you can choose one in **Settings → General → Language**. - Dates and counts follow the language you choose (“1 item”, “3 items”).

## First public release
Brisa frees up space on your Mac safely: it shows what it found, how much you can recover and asks before deleting anything.
### Overview (Resumen) - Disk usage at a glance, the status of each tool and **Analizar todo** (⇧⌘R) to run every scan at once.
### Smart cleanup (Limpieza inteligente) - App caches, old logs, temporary files, Xcode derived data and the Trash. - Skips caches and temporary files used in the last 24 hours, so apps you're using aren't affected.
### Storage (Espacio) - Large files, apps you haven't used in more than 180 days, leftover installers (`.dmg`, `.pkg`, `.ipsw`, `.xip`) and unavailable iOS simulators. - Files and apps are moved to the Trash, never deleted outright.
### Uninstaller (Desinstalador) - Removes apps together with their hidden data in your Library (preferences, caches, support files), with a sortable, searchable list.
### Development (Desarrollo) - **pnpm**: prune the store safely with `pnpm store prune`, find old store versions no project uses and clear the metadata cache. - npm, Yarn and Bun global caches and `npx`. - Project `node_modules` (with package manager and age), build caches from Next.js, Turborepo, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Parcel and Angular, and Rust `target` folders. - Caches from pip, uv, Go, Gradle, Cargo, CocoaPods, SwiftPM, Deno, Playwright, Puppeteer, Cypress and more. - Docker images and BuildKit cache (local contexts only).
### Ports (Puertos) - See which processes are listening on TCP ports and stop them.
### History (Historial) - A record of your scans and cleanups and the space you recovered.
### Automatic updates - Brisa now updates itself. Check anytime from **Brisa → Buscar actualizaciones…** or in **Configuración → Actualizaciones**.
The app is in Spanish. Requires macOS 14 or later. Native app for Apple silicon and Intel.
